## Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 API {#gemini-omni-flash-1-1-api}

Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 是 Google 推出的文生视频、图生视频、参考生视频、视频编辑模型，可通过 Venice API 以 `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video` 调用。请求经过匿名化处理，服务商始终无法获知您的身份。

### Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 API 价格 {#gemini-omni-flash-1-1-api-pricing}

| 模型 ID | 变体 | 隐私 | 价格 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video` | 文生视频 | Anonymized | $0.0389 / 秒 起 |
| `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-image-to-video` | 图生视频 | Anonymized | $0.0389 / 秒 起 |
| `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-reference-to-video` | 参考生视频 | Anonymized | $0.0389 / 秒 起 |
| `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-video-to-video` | 视频编辑 | Anonymized | 按源视频定价 |

`gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video` 的片段价格（无音频）：

| 时长 | 360p | 720p | 1080p | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4s | $0.16 | $0.47 | $0.70 | $1.40 |
| 6s | $0.23 | $0.70 | $1.05 | $2.10 |
| 8s | $0.31 | $0.93 | $1.40 | $2.80 |
| 10s | $0.39 | $1.17 | $1.75 | $3.50 |

### 如何使用 Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 API {#how-to-use-the-gemini-omni-flash-1-1-api}

使用 `"model": "gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video"` 和您的 API 密钥向 `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` 发送请求。

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "4s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
